creatures.name: Sluice Ash-Hound
creatures.description: A gaunt, pale-eyed scavenger hound raised on warm furnace runoff beneath the Weir-Port sluices.

actions.name: Cinder-Bite
actions.description: snaps with soot-blackened jaws

actions.name: Hamstring Lunge
actions.description: lunges low to tear at your heel

creatures.name: Black-Ledger Cutthroat
creatures.description: A desperate dockside thug hired by private debt-brokers to corner unstamped arrivals on the Drowned Piers.

actions.name: Stiletto Thrust
actions.description: jabs a narrow iron stiletto toward your ribs

actions.name: Salt-Dust Toss
actions.description: flings stinging brine-dust across your eyes

creatures.name: Chancery Debt-Bailiff
creatures.description: Armored in brass tally-plates and carrying a weighted audit baton, enforcing Chancery seizures without sentiment.

actions.name: Brass Baton Smash
actions.description: swings a heavy stamped-brass mace

actions.name: Seizure Shackle
actions.description: whips an iron tally-chain around your stance

creatures.name: Lantern-Wall Arbalest
creatures.description: A clockwork-crossbow sharpshooter trained to fire from behind a shield-line of bailiffs.

actions.name: Brass Bolt
actions.description: looses a whistling brass quarrel from cover

actions.name: Pinning Shot
actions.description: fires a barbed bolt aimed to pin your footing

creatures.name: Kiln-Stoked Ash-Automaton
creatures.description: A riveted brass-and-slag labor frame powered by bottled soul-ash, repurposed by the Furnace Guild to break quarry strikes.

actions.name: Crucible Slam
actions.description: brings down a glowing slag-iron fist

actions.name: Ash-Vent Blast
actions.description: vents scalding furnace embers across the ground

creatures.name: Furnace Guild Overseer
creatures.description: A brutal kiln foreman armored in slag-plate who treats human memory as mere fuel tonnage.

actions.name: Slag-Cleaver Chop
actions.description: hacks fiercely with a notched slag-cleaver

actions.name: Branding Hook
actions.description: rakes a red-hot kiln hook across your guard

creatures.name: Pale-Salt Jackal
creatures.description: A crystal-maned frontier predator adapted to hunt stragglers across the Bleached Salt-Flats.

actions.name: Salt-Fang Tear
actions.description: rips forward with salt-encrusted fangs

actions.name: Mineral Spray
actions.description: lashes its crystallized tail in a stinging arc

creatures.name: Whispering Mire-Wraith
creatures.description: The drifting remnant of an abandoned soul whose name was erased from the Chancery ledgers, murmuring half-forgotten mortal songs.

actions.name: Lullaby Chill
actions.description: whispers a hollow mortal lullaby that freezes the blood

actions.name: Mist-Tendril
actions.description: drains warmth with pale shroud-filaments

creatures.name: Fulgurite Shard-Kite
creatures.description: A razor-winged glass predator born where lightning melts ash-storms across the Shattered Glass Steppe.

actions.name: Vitrified Feather Volley
actions.description: hurls ringing slivers of fulgurite glass from aloft

actions.name: Static Dive
actions.description: stoops with crackling glass talons

creatures.name: Oath-Broken Sentinel
creatures.description: Once a decorated Pale Frontier Warden, mutated by years of exposure to raw soul-ash; still guards the Bridge of Whispered Oaths with grim dignity.

actions.name: Ivory Greatsword
actions.description: sweeps an ancient mist-ivory blade in disciplined arcs

actions.name: Vigilant Shield-Check
actions.description: slams forward with calcified battle-plate

creatures.name: Bell-Cantor Mender
creatures.description: A renegade brass-cantor who rings discordant hand-bells to knit allies' wounds and shatter foes' focus.

actions.name: Resonant Knell
actions.description: strikes a dull bronze chime that rattles your teeth

actions.name: Tolling Mend
actions.description: rings a harmonic chime to knit a wounded ally's frame

creatures.name: Foreman Krag, the Crucible Warden
creatures.description: An immense Furnace Guild chief whose lungs were replaced with brass bellows to survive forty years inside the Smoking Cinder Kilns.

actions.name: Furnace Cleaver
actions.description: swings a glowing two-handed crucible cleaver

actions.name: Bellows Roar
actions.description: exhales a choking gust of red-hot ash and sparks

creatures.name: Serena of the Weeping Orchard
creatures.description: A former Frontier Captain whose body crystallized into weeping amber while guarding refugees abandoned by the Chancery. Tragic, lucid, and terrifying when provoked.

actions.name: Amber Halberd Sweep
actions.description: drives a resin-gleaming halberd with mourning precision

actions.name: Sorrow's Snare
actions.description: binds your footing in hardening amber tears

creatures.name: Regent Malcor of the Unwritten
creatures.description: Once a principled Chancery magistrate exiled beyond the Lantern-Wall for exposing soul-harvesting; hardened into the fierce, bone-armored sovereign of the Hollow Nave.

actions.name: Unwritten Verdict
actions.description: cleaves downward with an ancient ossuary blade

actions.name: Weight of Erased Names
actions.description: invokes a chorus of forgotten debtors that presses down upon your shoulders

creatures.name: The Echo-Warden of the Vault
creatures.description: A towering mirror-masked construct woven from thousands of confiscated mortal memories, bound to guard the Vault of Unpaid Echoes.

actions.name: Mirror-Shard Arc
actions.description: flings spinning crescents of obsidian mirror-glass

actions.name: Mnemonic Drain
actions.description: floods your mind with stolen fragments of dying strangers

creatures.name: High Auditor Crassus of the First Scale
creatures.description: The architect of the modern Chancery's immortal aristocracy. Cold, eloquent, and convinced that without his merciless machinery the Threshold would dissolve into oblivion.

actions.name: Gavel of the First Scale
actions.description: brings down the blazing Scepter of the Broken Scale

actions.name: Audit of Compounded Debt
actions.description: binds your soul-tally in searing brass chains of debt
